#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

namespace My {
    class Scanner {
        private:
            static const int BUF_SIZE = 2048;
            char buf[BUF_SIZE];
            int buf_pos = 0, buf_size = 0;
            istream& in;

            void fillBuffer() {
                in.read(buf, BUF_SIZE);
                buf_size = in.gcount();
                buf_pos = 0;
            }

        public:
            Scanner(istream& is = cin): in(is) {}

            string next() {
                string res;
                while (true) {
                    if (buf_pos >= buf_size) {
                        fillBuffer();
                        if (buf_size == 0) return "";
                    }
                    while (buf_pos < buf_size && isspace(buf[buf_pos])) {
                        buf_pos++;
                    }
                    if (buf_pos >= buf_size) continue;
                    while (buf_pos < buf_size && !isspace(buf[buf_pos])) {
                        res += buf[buf_pos++];
                    }
                    if (!res.empty()) break;
                }
                return res;
            }

            int nextInt() {
                return stoi(next());
            }

            long long nextLong() {
                return stoll(next());
            }

            double nextDouble() {
                return stod(next());
            }
    };
}

long long mod_mul(long long a, long long b) {
    return ((a % mod) * (b % mod)) % mod;
}

long long mod_sum(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a + b) % mod;

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

vector<bool> prime(int num) {
    vector<bool> bools(num, true);
    if (num >= 0) {
        bools[0] = false;
        if (num > 1) bools[1] = false;
    }
    for (int i=2; i<=int(sqrt(num)); i++) {
        if (bools[i]) {
            for (int j=i*i; j<num; j += i) {
                bools[j] = false;
            }
        }
    }
    return bools;
}

// Computes modular inverse assuming prime modulus
long long modInverse(long long a, long long m) {
    // Fermat's little theorem: a^(m-2) mod m
    long long result = 1;
    long long base = a % m;
    long long exp = m - 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % m;
        base = (base * base) % m;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a / gcd(a, b)) * b;
}

int lcm(int a, int b) {
    return (a / gcd(a, b)) * b;
}

long long power(long long x, long long y, long long m) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long base = x % m;
    long long exp = y;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % m;
        base = (base * base) % m;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

class Combinations {
    vector<long long> z, z1, z2;
    long long mod;

public:
    Combinations(long long N, long long mod): mod(mod) {
        z.resize(N+1);
        z1.resize(N+1);
        z2.resize(N+1);
        z[0] = 1;
        for (long long i=1; i<=N; i++) {
            z[i] = (z[i-1] * i) % mod;
        }
        z2[0] = 1;
        z2[1] = 1;
        for (long long i=2; i<=N; i++) {
            z2[i] = (z2[(int)(mod % i)] * (mod - mod / i)) % mod;
        }
        z1[0] =1;
        z1[1]=1;
        for (long long i=2; i<=N; i++) {
            z1[i] = (z2[i] * z1[i-1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    long long fac(long long n) {
        return z[(int)n];
    }

    long long invrsNum(long long n) {
        return z2[(int)n];
    }

    long long invrsFac(long long n) {
        return invrsNum(n);
    }

    long long ncr(long long N, long long R) {
        if (R<0 || R>N) return 0;
        return ((z[(int)N] * z1[(int)R]) % mod * z1[(int)(N - R)]) % mod;
    }
};

class DisjointUnionSets {
public:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;

    DisjointUnionSets(int n): n(n) {
        rank.resize(n, 0);
        parent.resize(n);
        makeSet();
    }

    void makeSet() {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            parent[i]=i;
        }
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }

    void union_sets(int x, int y) {
        int xRoot = find(x);
        int yRoot = find(y);
        if (xRoot == yRoot) return;
        if (rank[xRoot] < rank[yRoot]) {
            parent[xRoot] = yRoot;
        } else if (rank[yRoot] < rank[xRoot]) {
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
        } else {
            parent[yRoot] = xRoot;
            rank[xRoot]++;
        }
    }
};

vector<int> KMP(const string& str) {
    int n = (int)str.size();
    vector<int> kmp(n,0);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int j=kmp[i-1];
        while (j>0 && str[i]!=str[j]) {
            j=kmp[j-1];
        }
        if (str[i]==str[j]) j++;
        kmp[i]=j;
    }
    return kmp;
}
